annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandates brake assist systems in new M1 and N1 vehicles to protect pedestrians.
Sets headform and legform impact test limits for vehicles and frontal protection systems.
Requires EC type-approval and marking for frontal protection systems.
Allows Commission to assess collision avoidance systems as alternatives to passive requirements.
Requires Member States to set effective, proportionate, dissuasive penalties for manufacturer infringements.
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 78/2009 on type-approval of motor vehicles for pedestrian and vulnerable road user protection. It mandates brake assist and impact-test requirements for M1/N1 vehicles and frontal protection systems, sets type-approval procedures and penalties, and repeals earlier directives. Only tangentially related to autonomous systems via collision-avoidance provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 January 2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
